title: Lakehouse Architecture — Companion Pipeline Scripts

description: Runnable medallion pipeline scripts: Bronze-to-Silver merge, Silver-to-Gold aggregates, Delta maintenance (OPTIMIZE/Z-ORDER/VACUUM/manifest), Iceberg setup with partition evolution, and Hudi upserts with incremental reads.
